title: WaterHouse 401 | 3BR Condo in Seacrest Beach
meta_description: WaterHouse 401: 3BR, 3BA top-floor condo in Seacrest Beach 30A with a rooftop pool, Gulf views, and beach access 100 feet away. Sleeps 8.
description_expanded: Description: WaterHouse 401 by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Address: 8377 E County Highway 30A, Unit 401 Details: Welcome to WaterHouse 401! Look no further for your home away from home! This spacious three-bedroom condo is just steps from the Gulf of Mexico and is centrally located between Rosemary Beach and Seaside. WaterHouse 401 boasts breathtaking views from the moment you walk through the front door! This condo is thoughtfully designed for relaxation, including the large balcony overlooking Scenic Highway 30A. The WaterHouse complex consists of four floors with a rooftop pool and spa, two community grills, a fitness center, and an outside shower. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Parking Spaces: 2 Spaces in Lot -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 7, Bar Seating for 5 -Coffee Maker Available -Community Grill Available -Access to Community Pool -Access to Fitness Center -WaterHouse Provisions + Bottleshop located on 1st floor of building -Beach Towel Service Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 7 3 Bedrooms / 3 Bathrooms Main Floor: -Bedroom 1 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Bedroom 2: Queen Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 3: Queen Bed with Shared Bath (Shower) -Sleeper Sofa in Living Room -Laundry Room Amenities Include: -2 Adult Bikes Please Note: -The beach access directly across 30A is temporarily closed for repairs. Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
